newsitem.title: FRANCE: GdesEaux unit in real estate deal.
newsitem.headline: GdesEaux unit in real estate deal.

text.p: Compagnie Generale d'Immobilier (CGIP), a unit of Generale des Eaux, said in a statement on Wednesday it had concluded property deals worth 4.2 billion francs.

It said it had signed an agreement with SITQ Immobilier, a unit of Caisse de depot et placement du Quebec, to sell its holdings in the Esplanade and Pacific office towers in the La Defense Paris area.
Property company Lucia, which has a 30 percent stake in Esplanade, will participate in the deal, allowing SITQ to buy the towers for 2.5 billion francs before June 30.
CGIS will also become 20 percent partner in a joint-venture with SITQ which will buy the Michelet, Utopia and Diamant buildings in La Defense from CGIS and has an option on the Prisma tower.
Lucia has an option to invest the procceeds of the Esplanade sale in the joint-venture.
CGIS said the sale would lead to a "slight loss" of less than five percent of the transaction value in either provisions or exceptional losses.
CGIS said that in the past nine months it had sold assets worth nine billion francs.
